This is a unit reference, not a treatment setting recommendation. The
Common pressures at a glance
Pressure and oxygen are separate
ATA describes the total absolute pressure. Oxygen percentage describes
The conversion relationships
Absolute psi = ATA × 14.696
Gauge psi = (ATA − 1) × 14.696
kPa = ATA × 101.325
mmHg = ATA × 760
Sea water feet = (ATA − 1) × 33
Oxygen partial pressure = ATA × oxygen percentage ÷ 100
The reference assumes standard sea-level atmospheric pressure. Gauge v
